_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: From here it can happen any day
title.hi: यहाँ से यह किसी भी दिन हो सकता है

body.en: Full term is close. Keep your phone charged and loud, tell work, and stop making plans you cannot leave. Readiness is mostly logistics.
body.hi: पूरा समय क़रीब है। फ़ोन चार्ज और आवाज़ पर रखिए, काम पर बता दीजिए, और ऐसी योजनाएँ बनाना बंद कीजिए जिन्हें बीच में छोड़ न सकें। तैयारी ज़्यादातर इंतज़ाम ही है।
